<script>
(function(){
  // in-page links: smooth scroll to the section, keep the URL free of anchors
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var t = e.target;
    var a = t && t.closest ? t.closest('a[href^="#"]') : null;
    if(!a) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (window.history && history.replaceState) history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search);
    var id = (a.getAttribute('href')||'').slice(1);
    var el = id ? document.getElementById(id) : null;
    if(!el){ window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'}); return; }
    var hd = document.querySelector('header');
    var off = (hd ? hd.getBoundingClientRect().height : 0) + 12;
    window.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - off, 0), behavior:'smooth' });
  });

  // FAQ accordion: opening one answer closes the others
  var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#duvidas .space-y-3 > div'));
  function closeAll(except){
    items.forEach(function(o){
      if (o === except) return;
      var op = o.querySelector('p'), om = o.querySelector('button span');
      if (op) op.style.display = 'none';
      if (om) om.textContent = '+';
    });
  }
  items.forEach(function(it){
    var b = it.querySelector('button'), p = it.querySelector('p');
    if(!b || !p) return;
    var mark = b.querySelector('span');
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var open = p.style.display === 'none';
      closeAll(it);
      p.style.display = open ? '' : 'none';
      if (mark) mark.textContent = open ? '\u2212' : '+';
    });
  });
})();
</script>

</body></html>
